headline: Vistra Declares Dividend on Common Stock and Series A Preferred Stock
summary: Vistra (NYSE: VST) announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.23 per share of Vistra's common stock, reflecting an estimated aggregate payment of approximately $75 million this quarter. The common dividend is payable on Sept. 30, 2026, to common stockholders of record as of Sept. 21, 2026. The ex-dividend date for the common dividend will be Sept. 21, 2026.

headline: Edison International to Release Q2 Earnings: What's in Store?
summary: EIX's Q2 results are likely to reflect grid investments, rate-case support, rising demand and tighter cost controls.
